name: Sentient Holographic Neuro-Lace Matrix
description: Fly down a channel of an endless teal holographic gyroid lace. A breathing lace wave swells the sheets in bass-driven crests that roll away down the flight axis, bioluminescent depth fog dissolves distant lace into haze lit by how many strands each ray grazed, and the pointer gathers the lace toward a node that travels with the camera; holding the mouse blooms it into a glowing neuron that lights the surrounding strands.
